q.g: In this quest you have to stash an Arena advertisement poster in the living quarters of the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons on Customs. 3 posters are provided by Skier via in-game mail. While a poster can't be put directly in secure containers, it can be put into a Documents case or S I C C organizational pouch to prevent losing it upon death. The poster has to be stashed at one of five beds on the first floor.
